battery_performance.description: Battery drain, rapid percentage drop, overheating/thermal issues, charging failure, or battery health degradation.
examples: My iPhone 8 battery drains from 100% to 20% in 2 hours without using it. Is iOS 11 causing this?
Phone gets extremely hot while charging and battery icon is stuck at 80%.
Battery health dropped to 79% and it shuts down unexpectedly at 30%.

software_bug_ios.description: Operating system anomalies, app crashes, touchscreen freezing, keyboard lag, Bluetooth/Wi-Fi glitches, or update installation errors.
examples: Ever since updating to iOS 11.1, the YouTube app freezes and my phone will not lock.
Calculator app adds numbers incorrectly when typing quickly. 1+2+3 gives 24!
My lock screen clock disappeared and music controls do not respond.

account_appleid_icloud.description: Apple ID account lockouts, 2-factor authentication codes, forgotten passwords/passcodes, iCloud storage full, and backup sync issues.
examples: I forgot my Apple ID password and the recovery email is an old address I cannot access.
My Apple ID has been disabled for security reasons, how can I unlock it?
iCloud backup says not enough storage even though I just upgraded to 50GB.

hardware_damage_repair.description: Physical damage including cracked glass/screens, liquid damage, camera breakage, swollen battery housing, or physical button failure.
examples: Dropped my iPhone X on concrete and the back glass completely shattered.
My phone fell in the pool and will not turn on even after drying for 2 days.
The battery has swollen and is pushing the screen off the frame.

warranty_applecare.description: Inquiries about AppleCare+ warranty coverage, policy expiration dates, repair status tracking, transfer of coverage, or deductibles.
examples: How do I check if my MacBook Pro is still covered under AppleCare+?
I sent my iPhone in for repair 5 days ago, repair ID 1092837. What is the status?
Does AppleCare+ cover accidental liquid damage if I bought it in the UK?

purchase_billing.description: Unknown credit card charges from Apple.com/bill, unauthorized in-app purchases, subscription cancellations, refunds, or gift card errors.
examples: I was charged .99 on my credit card from Apple but I do not have any active subscriptions.
My child made an accidental  in-app purchase in Roblox, I need an immediate refund.
App Store redeemed code says it has already been redeemed, please help.

device_setup_howto.description: Guidance on initial device setup, data migration from Android/PC, Quick Start, AirDrop configuration, or enabling specific settings.
examples: How do I transfer my WhatsApp chats and photos from Android to my new iPhone 11?
How do I enable dark mode and configure Do Not Disturb while driving?
Setting up new iPad for my elderly mother, how do I restrict in-app purchases?

product_availability_preorder.description: Device launch dates, stock availability in Apple retail stores, shipping/delivery windows, trade-in values, or pre-order status.
examples: When will iPhone X 256GB Space Gray be in stock for pickup at the Regent Street Apple Store?
My pre-order says preparing to ship, will it arrive on Friday launch day?
What is the trade-in value of an iPhone 6s in good condition towards an iPhone 8?

general_feedback_other.description: Catch-all category for customer compliments, general complaints without actionable technical issues, spam, or ambiguous/fragmented queries.
examples: Shoutout to the Genius Bar team at Fifth Ave store for fixing my Mac in 30 mins! You rock!
Apple is the worst company ever, I hate the new design changes.
Hey @AppleSupport can someone help me please?
